panels.description: Il calendario in alto filtra per data di creazione TIN (fuso Europe/Rome). Elenco basato su TIN: verifica se ogni bolla/riga esiste su Boom. Le bolle presenti solo su Boom non compaiono. Data bolla dal/al filtra opzionalmente per data documento. Ogni blocco colorato (Righe, Pezzi, Kg, …) ha tre colonne: TIN, Boom e Diff. Legenda blocchi: stesso colore di sfondo per le 3 colonne di un blocco; TIN = tono azzurro, Boom = tono verde, Diff verde = ok, Diff rosata = differenza. Colonna grigia = separatore tra blocchi.

properties.value: Motivo segnalato da TIN/Boom tradotto in linguaggio operativo (accordo, articolo, negozio, ecc.).
Descrizione in linguaggio semplice del risultato.
Nome file interfaccia TIN: discrimina i caricamenti della stessa bolla.
Transaction code TIN: identifica ogni singolo caricamento del file.

targets.rawSql:
-- Quadratura totali bolla: tipo gestione da anagrafica Boom (unità di giacenza)
-- PEZZI (UM PZ): totali e confronto solo su pezzi/colli/valore pezzi
-- PESO  (UM KG): totali e confronto solo su kg/valore kg
-- Calendario Grafana = creation_date su TIN. Elenco bolle = solo interfaccia TIN; confronto LEFT JOIN su Boom (TSM).

WITH scope AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(tin.document_number) AS documento, tin.document_date AS data_documento, tin.network AS negozio, tin.file_name AS file_tin, tin.transaction_code AS transaction_code
    FROM boom.tin_data_reception_in tin
WHERE tin.source_type_pc = 30
      AND (tin.creation_date)::date >= (((timestamptz 'epoch' + (CASE WHEN ${__from} > 1000000000000 THEN (${__from} * interval '1 millisecond') ELSE (${__from} * interval '1 second') END))) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Rome')::date AND (tin.creation_date)::date <= (((timestamptz 'epoch' + (CASE WHEN GREATEST(${__to}, ${__from}) > 1000000000000 THEN (GREATEST(${__to}, ${__from}) * interval '1 millisecond') ELSE (GREATEST(${__to}, ${__from}) * interval '1 second') END))) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Rome')::date
      AND (NULLIF('${data_bolla_dal}', '') IS NULL OR tin.document_date >= NULLIF('${data_bolla_dal}', '')::date)
      AND (NULLIF('${data_bolla_al}', '') IS NULL OR tin.document_date <= NULLIF('${data_bolla_al}', '')::date)
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${negozio:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR tin.network = ANY(string_to_array('${negozio:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${numero_bolla:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR TRIM(tin.document_number) = ANY(string_to_array('${numero_bolla:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${articolo:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR tin.item = ANY(string_to_array('${articolo:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
),
tin AS (
    SELECT
        TRIM(tin.document_number) AS documento,
        tin.document_date AS data_documento,
        MAX(net.description) AS negozio,
        MAX(tin.network) AS numero_negozio,
        MAX(tin.file_name) AS file_tin,
        MAX(tin.transaction_code) AS transaction_code,
        STRING_AGG(
            DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(tin.error_message), ''),
            ' | ' ORDER BY NULLIF(TRIM(tin.error_message), '')
        ) AS motivo_squadratura,
        COUNT(*) AS righe_tin,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) = 'PZ') AS righe_pezzi_tin,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) <> 'PZ') AS righe_kg_tin,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) = 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tin.quantity_pieces, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS pezzi_tin,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) = 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tin.quantity_packs, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS colli_tin,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) = 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tin.quantity_pieces, 0) * COALESCE(tin.net_net_price, tin.net_price, tin.gross_price, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END), 3) AS val_pezzi_tin,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) <> 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tin.quantity_weight, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kg_tin,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) <> 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tin.quantity_weight, 0) * COALESCE(tin.net_net_price, tin.net_price, tin.gross_price, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END), 3) AS val_kg_tin,
        MAX(tin.creation_date) AS data_creazione,
        BOOL_OR(COALESCE(tin.net_net_price, tin.net_price, tin.gross_price) IS NOT NULL) AS ha_prezzo_tin
    FROM boom.tin_data_reception_in tin
INNER JOIN scope s
      ON TRIM(tin.document_number) = s.documento
     AND tin.document_date = s.data_documento
     AND tin.network = s.negozio
     AND tin.file_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.file_tin
     AND tin.transaction_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.transaction_code
    LEFT JOIN boom.tmd_networks net ON net.network_code = tin.network
    LEFT JOIN boom.vmd_items vi ON vi.item = tin.item
    LEFT JOIN boom.vpa_parameters vp_su
      ON vp_su.parameter_header = vi.stock_unit_ph
     AND vp_su.parameter_code = vi.stock_unit_pc
     AND vp_su.is_default = 1
    WHERE tin.source_type_pc = 30
      AND (NULLIF('${data_bolla_dal}', '') IS NULL OR tin.document_date >= NULLIF('${data_bolla_dal}', '')::date)
      AND (NULLIF('${data_bolla_al}', '') IS NULL OR tin.document_date <= NULLIF('${data_bolla_al}', '')::date)
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${negozio:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR tin.network = ANY(string_to_array('${negozio:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${numero_bolla:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR TRIM(tin.document_number) = ANY(string_to_array('${numero_bolla:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${articolo:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR tin.item = ANY(string_to_array('${articolo:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
    GROUP BY TRIM(tin.document_number), tin.document_date, tin.network, tin.file_name, tin.transaction_code
),
tsm AS (
    SELECT
        TRIM(tsm.document_number) AS documento,
        tsm.document_date AS data_documento,
        MAX(net.description) AS negozio,
        MAX(net.network_code) AS numero_negozio,
        MAX(tsm.reception_code) AS codice_ricevimento,
        COUNT(*) AS righe_tsm,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) = 'PZ') AS righe_pezzi_tsm,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) <> 'PZ') AS righe_kg_tsm,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) = 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tsm_d.quantity_pieces, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS pezzi_tsm,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) = 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tsm_d.quantity_packs, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS colli_tsm,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) = 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tsm_d.quantity_pieces, 0) * COALESCE(tsm_d.net_net_price, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END), 3) AS val_pezzi_tsm,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) <> 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tsm_d.quantity_weight, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS kg_tsm,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE
                WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(vp_su.description, 'PZ')) <> 'PZ'
                THEN COALESCE(tsm_d.quantity_weight, 0) * COALESCE(tsm_d.net_net_price, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END), 3) AS val_kg_tsm,
        MAX(tsm.creation_date) AS data_creazione
    FROM boom.tsm_receptions tsm
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT documento, data_documento, negozio
        FROM scope
    ) s
      ON TRIM(tsm.document_number) = s.documento
     AND tsm.document_date = s.data_documento
    JOIN boom.tsm_receptions_detail tsm_d ON tsm_d.reception_id = tsm.id
    JOIN boom.tmd_networks net ON net.id = tsm.network_id
     AND net.network_code = s.negozio
    JOIN boom.tmd_items it ON it.id = tsm_d.item_id
    LEFT JOIN boom.vpa_parameters vp_su
      ON vp_su.parameter_header = it.stock_unit_ph
     AND vp_su.parameter_code = it.stock_unit_pc
     AND vp_su.is_default = 1
    WHERE COALESCE(tsm.status_pc, 0) <> 6
      AND RIGHT(TRIM(COALESCE(tsm.reception_code, '')), 4) <> '_ANN'
      AND RIGHT(TRIM(COALESCE(tsm.document_number, '')), 4) <> '_ANN'
      AND (NULLIF('${data_bolla_dal}', '') IS NULL OR tsm.document_date >= NULLIF('${data_bolla_dal}', '')::date)
      AND (NULLIF('${data_bolla_al}', '') IS NULL OR tsm.document_date <= NULLIF('${data_bolla_al}', '')::date)
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${negozio:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR net.network_code = ANY(string_to_array('${negozio:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${numero_bolla:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR TRIM(tsm.document_number) = ANY(string_to_array('${numero_bolla:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${numero_ricevimento:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR TRIM(tsm.reception_code) = ANY(string_to_array('${numero_ricevimento:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
      AND (
            COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${articolo:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
         OR it.item = ANY(string_to_array('${articolo:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
      )
    GROUP BY TRIM(tsm.document_number), tsm.document_date, net.network_code
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(tin.negozio, tsm.negozio) AS negozio,
        COALESCE(tin.numero_negozio, tsm.numero_negozio) AS numero_negozio,
        COALESCE(tin.documento, tsm.documento) AS numero_bolla,
        COALESCE(tin.data_documento, tsm.data_documento) AS data_bolla,
        tin.file_tin,
        tin.transaction_code,
        tsm.codice_ricevimento,
        tin.motivo_squadratura,
        COALESCE(tin.righe_tin, 0) AS righe_tin,
        COALESCE(tsm.righe_tsm, 0) AS righe_tsm,
        COALESCE(tin.righe_pezzi_tin, 0) AS righe_pezzi_tin,
        COALESCE(tsm.righe_pezzi_tsm, 0) AS righe_pezzi_tsm,
        COALESCE(tin.righe_kg_tin, 0) AS righe_kg_tin,
        COALESCE(tsm.righe_kg_tsm, 0) AS righe_kg_tsm,
        COALESCE(tin.pezzi_tin, 0) AS pezzi_tin_raw,
        COALESCE(tsm.pezzi_tsm, 0) AS pezzi_tsm_raw,
        COALESCE(tin.colli_tin, 0) AS colli_tin_raw,
        COALESCE(tsm.colli_tsm, 0) AS colli_tsm_raw,
        COALESCE(tin.kg_tin, 0) AS kg_tin_raw,
        COALESCE(tsm.kg_tsm, 0) AS kg_tsm_raw,
        COALESCE(tin.val_pezzi_tin, 0) AS val_pezzi_tin_raw,
        COALESCE(tsm.val_pezzi_tsm, 0) AS val_pezzi_tsm_raw,
        COALESCE(tin.val_kg_tin, 0) AS val_kg_tin_raw,
        COALESCE(tsm.val_kg_tsm, 0) AS val_kg_tsm_raw,
        COALESCE(tin.ha_prezzo_tin, FALSE) AS ha_prezzo_tin,
        tsm.documento IS NULL AS solo_tin,
        COALESCE(tin.righe_pezzi_tin, 0) > 0 AS confronta_pezzi,
        COALESCE(tin.righe_kg_tin, 0) > 0 AS confronta_kg,
        COALESCE(tsm.righe_pezzi_tsm, 0) > 0 AS tsm_ha_pezzi,
        COALESCE(tsm.righe_kg_tsm, 0) > 0 AS tsm_ha_kg,
        COALESCE(tin.data_creazione, tsm.data_creazione) AS data_creazione
    FROM tin
    LEFT JOIN tsm
      ON tin.documento = tsm.documento
     AND tin.data_documento = tsm.data_documento
     AND tin.numero_negozio = tsm.numero_negozio
),
quadratura AS (
    SELECT
        b.*,
        CASE
            WHEN b.solo_tin THEN 'SOLO SU TIN'
            WHEN b.righe_tin <> b.righe_tsm THEN 'SCONGRUENTE RIGHE'
            WHEN b.confronta_pezzi AND NOT b.confronta_kg AND b.tsm_ha_kg AND NOT b.tsm_ha_pezzi THEN 'SCONGRUENTE TIPO'
            WHEN b.confronta_kg AND NOT b.confronta_pezzi AND b.tsm_ha_pezzi AND NOT b.tsm_ha_kg THEN 'SCONGRUENTE TIPO'
            WHEN b.confronta_pezzi AND b.righe_pezzi_tin <> b.righe_pezzi_tsm THEN 'SCONGRUENTE RIGHE PEZZI'
            WHEN b.confronta_kg AND b.righe_kg_tin <> b.righe_kg_tsm THEN 'SCONGRUENTE RIGHE KG'
            WHEN b.confronta_pezzi AND (
                ABS(b.pezzi_tin_raw - b.pezzi_tsm_raw) > 0.001
            ) THEN 'SCONGRUENTE QUANTITA PEZZI'
            WHEN b.confronta_kg AND ABS(b.kg_tin_raw - b.kg_tsm_raw) > 0.001 THEN 'SCONGRUENTE QUANTITA KG'
            WHEN NOT b.ha_prezzo_tin THEN 'OK QTY / PREZZO TIN ASSENTE'
            WHEN b.confronta_pezzi AND ABS(b.val_pezzi_tin_raw - b.val_pezzi_tsm_raw) > 0.01 THEN 'SCONGRUENTE VALORE PEZZI'
            WHEN b.confronta_kg AND ABS(b.val_kg_tin_raw - b.val_kg_tsm_raw) > 0.01 THEN 'SCONGRUENTE VALORE KG'
            ELSE 'OK'
        END AS esito
    FROM base b
)
SELECT
    q.negozio AS "Negozio",
    q.numero_negozio AS "N. negozio",
    q.numero_bolla AS "N. bolla",
    q.codice_ricevimento AS "N. ricevimento",
    q.data_bolla AS "Data bolla",
    q.file_tin AS "File TIN",
    q.transaction_code AS "Transaction code",
    TO_CHAR(q.data_creazione, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') AS creation_date,
    CASE
    WHEN ((q.motivo_squadratura) COLLATE "C") IS NULL OR BTRIM(((q.motivo_squadratura) COLLATE "C")) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE BTRIM(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_replace(
                        regexp_replace(
                            regexp_replace(
                                regexp_replace(
                                    regexp_replace(
                                        regexp_replace(
                                            regexp_replace(
                                                ((q.motivo_squadratura) COLLATE "C"),
                                                'Elemento non trovato: Id Accordo, id:-1',
                                                'Accordo commerciale non trovato in Boom: manca il collegamento fornitore/contratto per questo negozio o documento.',
                                                'gi'
                                            ),
                                            'Elemento non trovato: Id Rete/Sito, id:-1',
                                            'Negozio non riconosciuto in Boom: codice rete o punto vendita assente o errato.',
                                            'gi'
                                        ),
                                        'Elemento non trovato: Id Articolo, id:-1',
                                        'Articolo non presente in anagrafica Boom: va creato oppure il codice inviato da TIN non è corretto.',
                                        'gi'
                                    ),
                                    'Elemento non trovato: ([^,]+), id:-1',
                                    'Dato anagrafico mancante in Boom (\1): verificare configurazione in anagrafica.',
                                    'gi'
                                ),
                                'Articolo ripetuto e riga accorpata',
                                'Lo stesso articolo compare più volte sulla bolla: Boom ha unificato le righe duplicate.',
                                'gi'
                            ),
                            'Non è possibile salvare il Dettaglio Ricevimento, ne esiste già uno',
                            'Riga già presente nel ricevimento Boom: stesso articolo, unità logistica e collo già registrati.',
                            'gi'
                        ),
                        'Errore testata ricevimento [^|]+ null',
                        'Errore in elaborazione dell''intestazione bolla: Boom non ha completato il salvataggio.',
                        'gi'
                    ),
                    'Documento [^|]+ articolo [^|]+ - null',
                    'Errore in elaborazione della riga articolo: Boom non ha restituito un dettaglio (verificare anagrafica e dati inviati).',
                    'gi'
                ),
                'Documento [A-Z]{2,4}\s+[^ ]+\s+articolo\s+([^ ]+)\s+-\s+',
                'Sull''articolo \1: ',
                'gi'
            ),
            'Errore testata ricevimento\s+[A-Z]{2,4}\s+[^ ]+\s+',
            '',
            'gi'
        )
    )
END
 AS "Spiegazione problema TIN",
    q.esito AS "Esito",
    CASE q.esito
        WHEN 'OK' THEN 'TIN e Boom quadrati su questa bolla.'
        WHEN 'OK QTY / PREZZO TIN ASSENTE' THEN 'Quantità allineate; prezzo TIN non disponibile per il confronto valore.'
        WHEN 'SOLO SU TIN' THEN 'Bolla presente in TIN, ricevimento Boom non trovato per stessa bolla/negozio/data.'
        WHEN 'SCONGRUENTE RIGHE' THEN 'Numero righe diverso tra TIN e Boom.'
        WHEN 'SCONGRUENTE TIPO' THEN 'Tipo gestione diverso (pezzi vs peso) tra TIN e Boom.'
        WHEN 'SCONGRUENTE RIGHE PEZZI' THEN 'Numero righe a pezzi diverso.'
        WHEN 'SCONGRUENTE RIGHE KG' THEN 'Numero righe a peso diverso.'
        WHEN 'SCONGRUENTE QUANTITA PEZZI' THEN 'Pezzi totali diversi.'
        WHEN 'SCONGRUENTE QUANTITA KG' THEN 'Kg totali diversi.'
        WHEN 'SCONGRUENTE VALORE PEZZI' THEN 'Valore pezzi diverso.'
        WHEN 'SCONGRUENTE VALORE KG' THEN 'Valore kg diverso.'
        ELSE 'Verificare i dettagli nelle colonne TIN / Boom.'
    END AS "Spiegazione esito",
    q.righe_tin AS "Righe TIN",
    q.righe_tsm AS "Righe TSM",
    q.righe_tin - q.righe_tsm AS "Diff righe",
    '' AS "__sep_pezzi__",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_pezzi THEN q.pezzi_tin_raw END AS "Pezzi TIN",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_pezzi THEN q.pezzi_tsm_raw END AS "Pezzi TSM",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_pezzi THEN ROUND(q.pezzi_tin_raw - q.pezzi_tsm_raw, 3) END AS "Diff pezzi",
    '' AS "__sep_colli__",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_pezzi THEN q.colli_tin_raw END AS "Colli TIN",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_pezzi THEN q.colli_tsm_raw END AS "Colli TSM",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_pezzi THEN ROUND(q.colli_tin_raw - q.colli_tsm_raw, 3) END AS "Diff colli",
    '' AS "__sep_val_pezzi__",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_pezzi THEN q.val_pezzi_tin_raw END AS "Valore pezzi TIN",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_pezzi THEN q.val_pezzi_tsm_raw END AS "Valore pezzi TSM",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_pezzi THEN ROUND(q.val_pezzi_tin_raw - q.val_pezzi_tsm_raw, 3) END AS "Diff valore pezzi",
    '' AS "__sep_kg__",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_kg THEN q.kg_tin_raw END AS "Kg TIN",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_kg THEN q.kg_tsm_raw END AS "Kg TSM",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_kg THEN ROUND(q.kg_tin_raw - q.kg_tsm_raw, 3) END AS "Diff kg",
    '' AS "__sep_val_kg__",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_kg THEN q.val_kg_tin_raw END AS "Valore kg TIN",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_kg THEN q.val_kg_tsm_raw END AS "Valore kg TSM",
    CASE WHEN q.confronta_kg THEN ROUND(q.val_kg_tin_raw - q.val_kg_tsm_raw, 3) END AS "Diff valore kg"
FROM quadratura q
WHERE ('${visualizza}' = 'tutto' OR q.esito <> 'OK')
  AND (
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM('${numero_ricevimento:raw}'), ''), 'GRAFANA_ALL') = 'GRAFANA_ALL'
     OR TRIM(q.codice_ricevimento) = ANY(string_to_array('${numero_ricevimento:csv}', ',')::varchar[])
  )
ORDER BY q.numero_bolla, q.data_bolla;

panels.title: Quadratura ricevimenti - testata bolle

list.definition: SELECT network_code AS __value, description || ' (' || network_code || ')' AS __text FROM boom.tmd_networks WHERE RIGHT(network_code, 1) <> 'V' ORDER BY description
list.label: Negozio
list.name: negozio
list.query: SELECT network_code AS __value, description || ' (' || network_code || ')' AS __text FROM boom.tmd_networks WHERE RIGHT(network_code, 1) <> 'V' ORDER BY description

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT reception_code AS __value, reception_code AS __text FROM (SELECT TRIM(reception_code) AS reception_code FROM boom.tin_data_reception_in WHERE source_type_pc = 30 AND reception_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(reception_code) <> '' AND creation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' UNION SELECT TRIM(tsm.reception_code) AS reception_code FROM boom.tsm_receptions tsm WHERE COALESCE(tsm.status_pc, 0) <> 6 AND RIGHT(TRIM(COALESCE(tsm.reception_code, '')), 4) <> '_ANN' AND tsm.reception_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(tsm.reception_code) <> '' AND tsm.creation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' ) r ORDER BY 1
list.label: Numero ricevimento
list.name: numero_ricevimento
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT reception_code AS __value, reception_code AS __text FROM (SELECT TRIM(reception_code) AS reception_code FROM boom.tin_data_reception_in WHERE source_type_pc = 30 AND reception_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(reception_code) <> '' AND creation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' UNION SELECT TRIM(tsm.reception_code) AS reception_code FROM boom.tsm_receptions tsm WHERE COALESCE(tsm.status_pc, 0) <> 6 AND RIGHT(TRIM(COALESCE(tsm.reception_code, '')), 4) <> '_ANN' AND tsm.reception_code IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(tsm.reception_code) <> '' AND tsm.creation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' ) r ORDER BY 1

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(document_number) AS __value, TRIM(document_number) AS __text FROM boom.tin_data_reception_in WHERE source_type_pc = 30 AND TRIM(document_number) <> '' AND creation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' ORDER BY 1

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(document_number) AS __value, TRIM(document_number) AS __text FROM boom.tin_data_reception_in WHERE source_type_pc = 30 AND TRIM(document_number) <> '' AND creation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days' ORDER BY 1
